# Oikos: Expose scoped Knoxx Lens policy evidence and complete gateway history

## Context

Planning only for private open-hax/oikos at /home/err/spaces/foresight/oikos. Desktop is a local-first shared workbench. Initial incoming proposal; planning review is not complete. Creation authorizes no implementation, live configuration, deployment, inference, upload or spending. This focused slice belongs to Oikos: GovOne egress admission and Knoxx Lens evidence.

## Outcome

Expose scoped Knoxx Lens policy evidence and complete gateway history.

## Scope

Integrate Lens audit evidence separate from raw data with nonstreaming complete-history gateway requests and untrusted-response validation.

## Non-goals

No alternate policy evaluator, direct provider retry, implicit approval from a free route, raw data in Lens evidence, or live cloud calls.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Auth scopes and deletion propagate through gateway/Lens without retaining raw private content as evidence.
- [ ] Complete history is bounded and nonstreaming; hostile cloud output is not authority; free proxx route still requires policy approval.

## Verification

Contract tests cover cross-scope denial, deletion readback, incomplete histories, gateway failure and prompt-injection output using synthetic responses only. These are future acceptance checks, not executed implementation evidence.

## Risks

A background exporter or derived label can bypass prompt-only policy; complete histories increase privacy impact.

## Source anchors

Dated planning evidence: 2026-11-03. Operator requirements are reported intent, not live runtime proof. Cross-repository absolute paths identify source ownership, not a promotion of domain authority.
- https://github.com/mojomast/govone
- /home/err/spaces/foresight/AGENTS.md
- /home/err/docs/notes/design/epic-emacs-mcp.md
- https://github.com/mojomast/govone is operator-specified integration identity; API compatibility requires inspection during implementation.

## Dependencies

- c703893f-aea4-41c2-9eab-c3bd37b28c9b (S6A)

S6A supplies scoped GovOne admission. Lens audit evidence stays separate from raw payload retention; complete-history and hostile-response fixtures are synthetic. Missing gateway/API compatibility is a blocker, not authorization to build a second policy engine or retry directly. Current native child prerequisites synchronized to the user-approved precise plan: c703893f-aea4-41c2-9eab-c3bd37b28c9b (S6A). Parent relationship is preserved and is not an implicit gating edge. All checks stated here are future acceptance requirements, not executed implementation results. Earlier dependency prose in historical comments is superseded by this correction for current execution edges; historical event/comment bytes remain unchanged. Policy correction — sandbox/dev and synthetic data only; no personal capture. Default raw retention is 24h images and 7d text; propagate deletion to derived/retrieval payloads, with explicit consent for accepted knowledge. Automatic actions are agent-owned-resources-only; operator resources need explicit approval. Existing models only; 12B download/load/restart is held. Any cloud experiment is synthetic, GovOne-authorized, verified free and 0 spend only; no allocation or inherited pilot budget. Remote publication remains held. Qualified program merges are authorized only after their required gates; this is not a readiness override, implementation permission or native review approval.
